days.label: Day 1 — kickoff
days.note: All seven tickets are ready for the connected doorbell delivery.

days.label: Day 2 — hardware starts
days.note: Alex starts the button and signal work while firmware waits for the interface.

days.label: Day 3 — firmware starts
days.note: Sam starts event delivery against the proposed hardware interface.

days.label: Day 4 — signal blocker
days.note: An unstable signal blocks HW-124; FW-46 is blocked by it in Jira, so the controller waits in red.

days.label: Day 5 — parallel progress
days.note: Morgan starts the notification experience while Riley builds the backend.

days.label: Day 6 — ticket unavailable
days.note: UX-89 is temporarily unavailable while backend integration begins.

days.label: Day 7 — blocker clears
days.note: The signal is stable again and the UX ticket is available; FW-46 still waits (grey) on the unfinished HW-124.

days.label: Day 8 — reviews open
days.note: Hardware and firmware PRs open as interrupt integration gets underway. Alert sound setting joins the epic without a diagram carrier.
